oracle_checks.violation_description: Dex accepted a SAMLResponse from a new flow while using RelayState from an old flow (cross-flow splicing / RelayState fixation).

sequences.description: RelayState overwrite/race: initiate one SP flow, then attempt two different SAMLResponses using the same RelayState but different NameIDs to see if the second can overwrite/complete the same transaction.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Same RelayState/flow context accepted a second SAMLResponse for a different principal (non-atomic flow completion / overwrite).

sequences.description: Cross-client code redemption: obtain an auth code via SAML login for client A, then attempt to redeem the same code using client B credentials to test whether the code is bound to the correct client/session (prevents cross-session splicing).
sequences.invariant_hypothesis: I3: Authorization codes produced by a SAML-brokered OIDC flow must be bound to the initiating OAuth client_id and must not be redeemable by a different client (no cross-session/client splicing).
